name: ticket
description: Automatic or paired, problem-focused ticket creation across Jira, Linear, and common Git hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Create tickets automatically or through pairing.
interface.longDescription: Ticket provides automatic and paired workflows for creating concise, problem-focused tickets in Jira, Linear, GitHub, Codeberg, Forgejo, GitLab, and Gitea through remembered MCP or CLI routing, project templates, assignment, and native iteration placement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ticket:create to choose auto or paired mode and create a concise, problem-focused ticket.
